findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 Features in Research Commands

evidence.observation: Multiple Phase 5 TODO comments found for Supabase authorization checking and memory integration

proposed_action.description: Implement Phase 5 Supabase authorization checking and integrate decision memory mapping or track via backlog issues

findings.expected_benefit: Completes core authorization and state persistence logic in research command flow

findings.title: Placeholder Query in Quality Forecasting

evidence.observation: TODO comment indicates quality_anomalies query is mocked/stubbed with empty array

proposed_action.description: Implement database query to fetch quality anomalies from quality_anomalies table

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures accurate anomaly reporting in platform quality forecasting

findings.title: Direct API Calls Bypass Model Router in Emergency Alert Processing

evidence.observation: Hardcoded calls to Gemini and Mistral directly access environment API keys rather than routing via model-router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert processing calls to utilize the model-router endpoint

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes model usage, ensures adherence to routing policies, and provides telemetry logging

findings.title: Missing Model Router Call Log File

evidence.observation: call_log_exists is false and log file is not found at configured path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Verify log directory exists and router process has write permissions to initialize call_log.jsonl

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into model router latency, call volume, and failure rates
